project_name.justification: The text announces a deal for the 'Elliot Lake Uranium Project ("Elliot Lake") located in Elliot Lake Ontario'.

company_name.justification: The press release is from 'Appia Rare Earths & Uranium Corp. (CSE: API) (OTCQX: APAAF) (FSE: A0I0) (MUN: A0I0) (BER: A0I0)(the "Company" or "Appia")' which is the owner and seller of the project.

ceo_buyer.justification: The buyer is identified as '15997356 Canada Inc. (the "Purchaser")'. No CEO is named for this entity. The CEO mentioned, Tom Drivas, is the CEO of the seller, Appia Rare Earths & Uranium Corp.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The purchaser has an 'option up to a 100% working interest', acquired in two stages: 51% initially, and then the 'remaining 49% interest'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is named the 'Elliot Lake Uranium Project' and the seller will retain a '2% Uranium Production Payment Royalty'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Appia Signs MOU to Option Elliot Lake Property' and the content is entirely about this transaction for the specified project.

currency.justification: The payments are listed in '$'. The currency is inferred as CAD because the seller (Appia) is a Canadian company listed on the CSE, and the project is located in Ontario, Canada.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of two tranches: an initial payment of $25 million for 51% interest and a subsequent payment of $50 million for the remaining 49%. 'The Purchaser can earn a 51% interest in Elliot Lake by paying $25 million... Upon the delivery of a bankable feasibility study, the Purchaser can earn the remaining 49% interest in Elliot Lake by paying $50 million to Appia.'

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the text only mention cash payments.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The transaction terms are broken down into explicit cash payments, not a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the text do not mention any issuance of shares as consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the text do not mention any share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the text do not mention any option payments as part of the consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares are being issued as part of the transaction consideration.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not mention any exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: A conditional exploration commitment exists: 'If the Purchaser has not delivered the bankable feasibility study... the Purchaser having the obligation to make the first $15 million in expenditures at Elliot Lake to maintain its 51% interest.'

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the deal terms, the seller, Appia, will retain a royalty. 'Appia will retain up to a 2% Uranium Production Payment Royalty and up to a 2% Net Smelter Returns Royalty in Elliot Lake'.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states: 'The Company also has a 100% interest in 13,008 hectares (32,143 acres), with rare earth elements and uranium deposits over five mineralized zones in the Elliot Lake Camp, Ontario.'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text specifies the area unit as hectares: 'The Company also has a 100% interest in 13,008 hectares... in the Elliot Lake Camp, Ontario.'

resource_size.justification: The text mentions 'uranium deposits over five mineralized zones' but does not provide a quantified statement of mineral resources with mass or volume units (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified as '15997356 Canada Inc.', which is described as a private company ('The Purchaser has the right to assign the MOU to another private or public company.'). No ticker or exchange is provided for the buyer.
